meta.name: WordDrill
meta.note: 词库由 FlowUs 生词页同步而来；新增单词请用 scripts/sync-from-flowus.py 或直接编辑本文件。

words.example: There was an abundance of food at the party.
words.exampleZh: 聚会上食物非常充足。

words.meaning: （教堂、剧院、超市、机舱等的）过道，通道
words.example: Please keep the aisle clear in case of an emergency.
words.exampleZh: 请保持过道畅通，以备紧急情况。

words.meaning: 诱惑力，魅力；v. 诱惑，吸引
words.example: The allure of the big city draws in young graduates every year.
words.exampleZh: 大城市的魅力每年都吸引着年轻毕业生。

words.example: She brewed an aromatic cup of coffee that instantly lifted everyone's spirits that morning.
words.exampleZh: 那天早上她煮了一杯香气浓郁的咖啡，立刻让大家心情振奋。

words.meaning: 强烈的愿望； 志向， 抱负
words.example: a high level of political aspiration
words.exampleZh: 崇高的政治抱负

words.example: the availability of cheap flights
words.exampleZh: 有廉价机票出售

words.meaning: 贫瘠的，荒芜的；（土地）不长植物的；不育的，不结果实的
words.example: Years of over-farming had left the soil barren.
words.exampleZh: 多年的过度耕作让这片土地变得贫瘠。

words.meaning: 贬低，轻视；使显得微不足道
words.example: Don't belittle her achievements — she worked hard for every one of them.
words.exampleZh: 别贬低她的成就，每一个都是她努力换来的。

words.example: At the end of this chapter there is a select bibliography of useful books.
words.exampleZh: 本章末尾附着有用书籍的精选书目。

words.example: The council decided to broaden the pavement.
words.exampleZh: 地方议会决定拓宽人行道。

words.example: With limited resources and a tight deadline, the team managed to cobble together a workable prototype.
words.exampleZh: 资源有限、工期又紧，团队还是设法仓促拼凑出一个可用的原型。

words.meaning: 平常的，普通的；n. 老生常谈
words.example: Smartphones have become commonplace in daily life.
words.exampleZh: 智能手机在日常生活中已变得司空见惯。

words.example: a consultancy firm
words.exampleZh: 咨询公司

words.meaning: 快递员；快递公司；v. 用快递寄送
words.example: The courier company guaranteed same-day delivery for all packages within the metropolitan area.
words.exampleZh: 这家快递公司承诺大都市区内的所有包裹当日送达。

words.example: Learning is a cumulative process.
words.exampleZh: 学习是个逐渐积累的过程。

words.meaning: （强光）使目眩，使眼花；使赞叹不已，使倾倒
words.example: The chef's innovative dish dazzled by combining flavors and textures in a way that delighted every guest.
words.exampleZh: 那位厨师的创意菜品把风味与口感巧妙结合，令每位客人都赞叹不已。

words.example: ‘I’m not going to do it,’ said Margaret decidedly.
words.exampleZh: “这件事我不做。” 玛格丽特坚决地说。

words.meaning: 拆卸； 使分开， 使分离
words.example: Please detach and fill out the application form.
words.exampleZh: 请撕下申请表并填好。

words.example: deviation from the normal procedure
words.exampleZh: 背离正常的程序

words.meaning: 看出， 察觉出； 识别， 认出
words.example: We could just discern a town in the distance.
words.exampleZh: 我们依稀看到远处有一座城镇。

words.example: A modification of the common-origin theory accounts for the density discrepancy .
words.exampleZh: 关于共同起源的理论，有一种改进的论点解释了密度的不符。

words.meaning: 变形；歪曲，曲解；扭曲，使变形
words.example: Tall buildings can distort radio signals.
words.exampleZh: 高大的建筑物会使无线电信号失真。

words.meaning: （~ on/upon）开始，着手（尤指新而艰难的事）；上船（或飞机）
words.example: She was excited to embark on her new career even though challenges lay ahead.
words.exampleZh: 尽管前路充满挑战，她仍为踏上新的职业道路而兴奋。

words.meaning: 涉足，初步尝试（make forays into）；（短暂）突袭
words.example: The company made its first foray into the electric-vehicle market.
words.exampleZh: 该公司首次涉足电动车市场。

words.meaning: 概括， 归纳， 推断； 普及
words.example: Critics love to generalize, to formulate trends into which all new work must be fitted, however contradictory.
words.exampleZh: 评论家喜欢概括，归纳出所有新作品都必须符合的趋势，不管它们是如何地不符。

words.meaning: 麻烦，烦人的事（口语）；v. 不断烦扰，纠缠
words.example: It was a big hassle trying to find parking in the crowded downtown area.
words.exampleZh: 在拥挤的市中心找停车位真是件麻烦事。

words.example: ...instructional material designed to help you with your lifestyle.
words.exampleZh: ...旨在为你的生活方式提供帮助的指导材料。

words.example: Tokyo is one of the largest metropolises in the world.
words.exampleZh: 东京是世界上最大的大都市之一。

words.meaning: 周期的； 定期的； 时而发生的；期刊
words.example: She made periodical visits to her dentist.
words.exampleZh: 她定期去看牙医。

words.example: The report says climate change could also increase the prevalence of dengue fever.
words.exampleZh: 报告表示，气候变化还有可能增加登革热的流行强度。

words.example: ...the advantages of quantitative and qualitative research.
words.exampleZh: …定量和定性研究的优点。

words.example: She remained resolute in her decision to study industrial design.
words.exampleZh: 她坚持学工业设计的决定毫不动摇。

words.example: He wiped the rim of the glass before pouring the wine.
words.exampleZh: 倒酒前他擦了擦杯口。

words.meaning: 避难所，庇护所；（鸟兽）保护区，禁猎区
words.example: The old church became a sanctuary for villagers seeking safety during the war.
words.exampleZh: 战争期间，这座老教堂成了村民寻求安全的避难所。

words.example: The government took measures to shore up the weakening economy.
words.exampleZh: 政府采取措施支撑走弱的经济。

words.meaning: 中风；一击，敲击；（游泳的）划水，泳姿；笔画，笔触；钟声
words.example: The painting was finished with a few bold strokes of the brush.
words.exampleZh: 这幅画以几笔大胆的笔触完成。

words.meaning: 阳光充足的，阳光普照的
words.example: The sun-drenched balcony was the perfect spot for her morning coffee and quiet reflection.
words.exampleZh: 那个阳光充沛的阳台是她早晨喝咖啡、安静沉思的绝佳去处。

words.example: The lake was utterly tranquil in the early morning light.
words.exampleZh: 清晨的阳光下，湖面一片宁静。

words.example: The company will unveil its new concept car next month.
words.exampleZh: 该公司下月将发布新款概念车。
